work.title: The First Part of Henry the Sixth
work.author: William Shakespeare

scene.label: Act 4, Scene 6
scene.title: SCENE VI. A field of battle.

content.text: Alarum. Excursions, wherein Talbot's son is hemmed about, and Talbot rescues him.

lines.text: Saint George and victory! Fight, soldiers, fight!
lines.plainText: Saint George and victory Fight soldiers fight

lines.text: The Regent hath with Talbot broke his word,
lines.plainText: The Regent hath with Talbot broke his word

lines.text: And left us to the rage of France his sword.
lines.plainText: And left us to the rage of France his sword

lines.text: Where is John Talbot? Pause, and take thy breath;
lines.plainText: Where is John Talbot Pause and take thy breath

lines.text: I gave thee life and rescued thee from death.
lines.plainText: I gave thee life and rescued thee from death

lines.text: O, twice my father, twice am I thy son!
lines.plainText: O twice my father twice am I thy son

lines.text: The life thou gav'st me first was lost and done,
lines.plainText: The life thou gav'st me first was lost and done

lines.text: Till with thy warlike sword, despite of fate,
lines.plainText: Till with thy warlike sword despite of fate

lines.text: To my determined time thou gav'st new date.
lines.plainText: To my determined time thou gav'st new date

lines.text: When from the Dauphin's crest thy sword struck fire,
lines.plainText: When from the Dauphin's crest thy sword struck fire

lines.text: It warm'd thy father's heart with proud desire
lines.plainText: It warm'd thy father's heart with proud desire

lines.text: Of bold-faced victory. Then leaden age,
lines.plainText: Of boldfaced victory Then leaden age

lines.text: Quicken'd with youthful spleen and warlike rage,
lines.plainText: Quicken'd with youthful spleen and warlike rage

lines.text: Beat down Alençon, Orleans, Burgundy,
lines.plainText: Beat down Alenon Orleans Burgundy

lines.text: And from the pride of Gallia rescued thee.
lines.plainText: And from the pride of Gallia rescued thee

lines.text: The ireful Bastard Orleans, that drew blood
lines.plainText: The ireful Bastard Orleans that drew blood

lines.text: From thee, my boy, and had the maidenhood
lines.plainText: From thee my boy and had the maidenhood

lines.text: Of thy first fight, I soon encountered,
lines.plainText: Of thy first fight I soon encountered

lines.text: And, interchanging blows, I quickly shed
lines.plainText: And interchanging blows I quickly shed

lines.text: Some of his bastard blood, and in disgrace
lines.plainText: Some of his bastard blood and in disgrace

lines.text: Bespoke him thus: "Contaminated, base,
lines.plainText: Bespoke him thus Contaminated base

lines.text: And misbegotten blood I spill of thine,
lines.plainText: And misbegotten blood I spill of thine

lines.text: Mean and right poor, for that pure blood of mine,
lines.plainText: Mean and right poor for that pure blood of mine

lines.text: Which thou didst force from Talbot, my brave boy."
lines.plainText: Which thou didst force from Talbot my brave boy

lines.text: Here, purposing the Bastard to destroy,
lines.plainText: Here purposing the Bastard to destroy

lines.text: Came in strong rescue. Speak, thy father's care,
lines.plainText: Came in strong rescue Speak thy father's care

lines.text: Art thou not weary, John? How dost thou fare?
lines.plainText: Art thou not weary John How dost thou fare

lines.text: Wilt thou yet leave the battle, boy, and fly,
lines.plainText: Wilt thou yet leave the battle boy and fly

lines.text: Now thou art seal'd the son of chivalry?
lines.plainText: Now thou art seal'd the son of chivalry

lines.text: Fly, to revenge my death when I am dead;
lines.plainText: Fly to revenge my death when I am dead

lines.text: The help of one stands me in little stead.
lines.plainText: The help of one stands me in little stead

lines.text: O, too much folly is it, well I wot,
lines.plainText: O too much folly is it well I wot

lines.text: To hazard all our lives in one small boat!
lines.plainText: To hazard all our lives in one small boat

lines.text: If I today die not with Frenchmen's rage,
lines.plainText: If I today die not with Frenchmen's rage

lines.text: Tomorrow I shall die with mickle age.
lines.plainText: Tomorrow I shall die with mickle age

lines.text: By me they nothing gain an if I stay;
lines.plainText: By me they nothing gain an if I stay

lines.text: 'Tis but the short'ning of my life one day.
lines.plainText: 'Tis but the short'ning of my life one day

lines.text: In thee thy mother dies, our household's name,
lines.plainText: In thee thy mother dies our household's name

lines.text: My death's revenge, thy youth, and England's fame.
lines.plainText: My death's revenge thy youth and England's fame

lines.text: All these and more we hazard by thy stay;
lines.plainText: All these and more we hazard by thy stay

lines.text: All these are saved if thou wilt fly away.
lines.plainText: All these are saved if thou wilt fly away

lines.text: The sword of Orleans hath not made me smart;
lines.plainText: The sword of Orleans hath not made me smart

lines.text: These words of yours draw life-blood from my heart.
lines.plainText: These words of yours draw lifeblood from my heart

lines.text: On that advantage, bought with such a shame,
lines.plainText: On that advantage bought with such a shame

lines.text: To save a paltry life and slay bright fame,
lines.plainText: To save a paltry life and slay bright fame

lines.text: Before young Talbot from old Talbot fly,
lines.plainText: Before young Talbot from old Talbot fly

lines.text: The coward horse that bears me fall and die!
lines.plainText: The coward horse that bears me fall and die

lines.text: And like me to the peasant boys of France,
lines.plainText: And like me to the peasant boys of France

lines.text: To be shame's scorn and subject of mischance!
lines.plainText: To be shame's scorn and subject of mischance

lines.text: Surely, by all the glory you have won,
lines.plainText: Surely by all the glory you have won

lines.text: An if I fly, I am not Talbot's son.
lines.plainText: An if I fly I am not Talbot's son

lines.text: Then talk no more of flight, it is no boot;
lines.plainText: Then talk no more of flight it is no boot

lines.text: If son to Talbot, die at Talbot's foot.
lines.plainText: If son to Talbot die at Talbot's foot

lines.text: Then follow thou thy desperate sire of Crete,
lines.plainText: Then follow thou thy desperate sire of Crete

lines.text: Thou Icarus; thy life to me is sweet.
lines.plainText: Thou Icarus thy life to me is sweet

lines.text: If thou wilt fight, fight by thy father's side,
lines.plainText: If thou wilt fight fight by thy father's side

lines.text: And, commendable proved, let's die in pride.
lines.plainText: And commendable proved let's die in pride
